digest.component_or_area: CLI command structure and bridge subcommand dispatcher
propositions: Establish nested `rebar bridge` CLI with only `preview` and `sync` verbs, where preview is read-only with dry-run mode and sync is mutating with live mode.
Unknown nested verbs must fail with valid choices and never dispatch to same-named top-level commands; help must be available and print usage without exposing internal vocabulary.
Preview performs zero Jira writes and zero ticket/bridge-state writes; sync performs persisted mutations from unbound remote-only issues while preserving unrelated state.
Reject --mode, --filter-local-ids, and arbitrary trailing arguments on both verbs to prevent callers from overriding the read/write distinction.
Public help output must exclude internal terms (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store) and numeric exit-code values.
Preserve legacy Mode/MODE_CAPS, gated_mode reconcile-check round trip, top-level doctor, and bridge command spellings (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck) unchanged.
